# Java exception renderer fixtures

These fixtures compare the shared Rust renderer with Pkl **0.32.0** and
Temurin **21.0.12.1+1**. They cover 54 synthetic throwable graphs under LF and
CRLF line-separator profiles, for 108 graph/profile combinations. They do not
establish that the evaluator captures Java-compatible implementation stacks.

`input/cases.txt` is the exact case roster. Each tab-separated model defines
throwables, stack frames, cause references, and ordered suppressed references.
String fields use `u` followed by hexadecimal UTF-16 units; `-` represents null.
`tools/M2JavaExceptionOracle.java` constructs actual Java throwables and invokes
the pinned Pkl renderer and catch formatter. Ordinary diagnostic text, release
information, and line separators are explicit inputs to the Rust component.
Expected bug diagnostics and traces are never generated by Rust.

The `lf/` and `crlf/` directories contain 4,796 result files. Each channel has a
Java UTF-8 `.bin` file and an original big-endian UTF-16 `.code-units.bin` file.
The Rust integration test checks complete bytes, including malformed surrogate
handling, control characters, color sequences, whitespace, URL encoding, frame
metadata, shared stack suffixes, cause cycles, and repeated suppressed nodes.
The test also rejects missing or unexpected result files.

The authoritative capture is `target/m2/stage130-java-03`. Its report records
the pinned JDK/JAR, helper and input identities, four successful commands,
source/runtime bookends, and original output hashes. The copy receipt is
`target/m2/stage130-prep-03/fixture-copy.json`. Capture 01 failed before launching
Java because of a launch-gate mismatch. Capture 02 is superseded: its custom
throwable description was constructed by the helper; capture 03 delegates
ordinary description rendering to Java's `Throwable.toString()` and validates
actual class identities. Both earlier acquisitions remain preserved.

Run the committed comparison with:

```sh
cargo test -p pkl-runtime --test m2_java_exception_renderer --locked
```

Regeneration requires the pinned oracle configuration and a fresh output
directory. The Java helper takes the model directory and destination directory
as its two arguments; its controlled stack-display flags require
`--add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED`. Retain separate JVM acquisitions
for LF and CRLF and preserve exact identities and raw channels. Merely replacing
expected bytes after a Rust failure does not establish compatibility.
